description: Searches the Customermates documentation (product guides and REST API reference). Matches the query's words in full text and, with AI credits, also by meaning. Required: query. Optional: locale (one of: en, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, nl; default en), source (one of: docs, api, all; default docs). Returns ranked pages with the best section of each (slug#anchor), then the best page's url and its snippet in text, plus up to 5 full matches as structured content. Links into the app in the docs are full URLs on this instance and open the reader's own workspace.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'webhook signature' or 'filter operators'

source.description: docs = product guides, api = REST endpoint reference, all = both

name: search_docs

anchor.description: Heading anchor of that section; empty for the opening text before the first heading

section.description: Heading path of the best matching section, joined by ' > '

title: Search documentation
